name: TheFinals Music Pack
teaser: Enjoy the electronic synthwave music feast brought by Embark!
description_html:
WARNING: DUE TO GOOGLE DRIVE DELETING FILES WHEN UNZIPPED DOWNLOAD BOBBY’s MUSIC PLAYER FIRST AND THEN THIS MOD. MOVE ONLY THE AUDIO FILES NOT THE DLL.

The mod adds The Finals game soundtrack created by Embrak, as well as a music track remixed by an independent artist, and removes certain inappropriate music tracks. All copyrights belong to the publisher Embark, Embark Studios, and the artists. Updated to version 3.11.X of SPT, and compatible with version 3.10.X. Installation instructions: drag the Bepin folder into the SPT directory.

Preview: https://www.bilibili.com/video/BV17iLnzVESJ/?spm_id_from=333.1387.favlist.content.click&vd_source=1b3c01b9ffef41ebb5d301dab9abe8ac

Get ready to ignite an electronic synthesis craze at TKF.!
